exposure: Birth preparedness and complication readiness plan
birth preparedness and complication readiness plan
finding: The incidence of puerperal sepsis was 7.27% and was associated with not attending formal education, cesarean delivery, premature rupture of membranes, complicated pregnancy, referral status, and absence of birth preparedness and complication readiness plan.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was a significant predictor of puerperal sepsis.
